messages:
Rory (Recruiter): Nadia accepted the offer yesterday for 2026-05-04 start but got an RFE on her EAD renewal. USCIS asked for additional employer letter. Can Redwood help? :worried:
Nadia P (New Hire): I got the RFE email this morning. It wants a letter confirming job duties and that the role is consistent with EAD category. I can upload the notice.
people-ops-bot: Document uploaded by Nadia P: rfe_notice_0501.pdf (HR secure bucket) :white_check_mark:
Priya - People Ops: We can provide a templated employer support letter but Legal must review. This is different from premium processing — it's USCIS asking for evidence. @Kasia can you draft/approve?
Kasia (Legal): We can prepare a letter confirming offer, job title, salary, and duties. Important to avoid immigration-specific language that creates risk. We'll need hiring manager to confirm duties and be copied. Also note: employer-provided letters don't guarantee outcome.
Omar (Payroll): Payroll note: even with RFE response, we still need final EAD card before paid work. But if RFE response is submitted and biometrics done, sometimes USCIS issues interim evidence. We'll rely on Legal's guidance.
Rory (Recruiter): Nadia's manager (Sam) confirmed duties in email. I'll attach that. Nadia, please upload the RFE and any supporting docs.
Nadia P (New Hire): Uploaded the RFE and Sam's job-duties email. Also uploaded my passport and I-94.
people-ops-bot: Documents uploaded by Nadia P: rfe_uploaded.pdf, sam_job_email.pdf, passport_i94.pdf :white_check_mark:
Kasia (Legal): Drafted employer support letter and posted it to HR secure. Rory, please review for accuracy. Once Nadia signs an authorization, we will transmit the letter via her attorney or directly per her preference.
Priya - People Ops: Good. Two practical questions: 1) Do we want to offer short-term contractor bridging if EAD delayed? 2) Do we want to pre-authorize reimbursement if Nadia uses premium or attorney fees to respond?
Omar (Payroll): For contractor bridging, payroll can set Nadia up as a vendor but that requires a different agreement and has tax/1099 implications. People Ops + Legal need to approve; Finance must sign off. Not ideal but possible for short windows.
Rory (Recruiter): Sam (hiring manager) prefers to keep Nadia as employee-only, but is open to unpaid orientation. Nadia, would you consider contractor bridge?
Nadia P (New Hire): I'm uncomfortable doing 1099—prefer unpaid orientation then paid upon EAD. If company can cover attorney letter transmission cost or reimburse it, that helps.
Kasia (Legal): We can reimburse reasonable attorney fees for preparing/submitting RFE materials on a case-by-case basis with pre-approval. We'll draft a short reimbursement form. Note: reimbursements may be taxable and require receipts.
Priya - People Ops: Action items:
- Kasia: finalize employer letter and reimbursement form (TODAY).
- Rory: confirm manager duties snippet matches letter and get Nadia's signature for release.
- Omar: flag payroll for holding until EAD card verification; note possibility of retro-pay if cleared before cutoff (5/18).
- Nadia: keep USCIS tracking and upload any updates.
people-ops-bot: Reminder set: "Check Nadia RFE response status" on 2026-05-08 09:00
Rory (Recruiter): I'll route the letter to Nadia's attorney this afternoon and update thread. Thanks all.
Priya - People Ops: Thanks team. We'll avoid contractor path unless absolutely necessary. We'll also offer orientation-only access and confirm benefits timing in the addendum. Closing for now. :thumbsup:
